
# Contributing

Thank you for considering contributing to this schema.

<br/>

## What

You can contribute in various ways, here are some of them.

<br/>

### General

-   More / improved examples

-   Improve tag documentation

-   Improve schema structuring

-   Repository documentation

-   Improve bundler script

<br/>

### `XML:Lang` Attribute Support

RedHat's VSCode Extension currently doesn't support  
`xml:lang` attributes for `<documentation>` tags  
properly, which causes them to render all tooltips  
instead of just the one that fits the user's language.

If this was implemented, the schema  
could support multiple languages.

\>\> See this [Issue][XML:Lang]

<br/>

###



[XML:Lang]: https://github.com/redhat-developer/vscode-xml/issues/1057
